summary: Connection plugins let Ansible reach targets (ssh, paramiko and local are most common, one per host). New ones are made by copying an existing plugin into the connection directory, and common options like timeout should keep the same defaults.
questions: How do I create a custom connection plugin for a new transport?
Can a host use more than one connection plugin at a time?
How do I support --timeout in my connection plugin?

answer_card.title: Connection plugins
answer_card.answer_md: Connection plugins connect to targets; only **one per host** at a time. Most common: `ssh`, `paramiko`, `local`. To add one (e.g. SNMP, message bus), copy an existing plugin's format into a `connection` directory on your plugin path. Support common options like `timeout` by documenting that attribute, keeping the same non-null default.
